body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> ERAE Electronics, and DIBOSS have presented their internet TVs ‘J2’, ‘Vitze’ at KES 2005. While ‘J2’ means that you can feel joy more than twice as much, Erae Electronics introduced a new concept of ‘TV portal’ under cooperation with Hanaro Communication, Korean internet portals service provider.

DIBOSS tried to deliver the message of ‘LCD TV that provides a vision’ with its ‘Vitze’. In order to emphasize entertainment function, it is equipped with big speakers under TV. <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
